paper_title: Spectrum of global string networks and the axion dark matter mass
notes: Theory/numerical paper: predicts the post-inflationary QCD axion dark matter mass m_a in (95-450) ueV (Eq. 1.2) from large-scale simulations of global string network axion radiation spectra. It does not report a new experimental or observational exclusion on any axion coupling. Figure 1 shows the axion-photon coupling plane (C_agamma vs m_a) with mass estimates from prior works and existing/future experimental constraints, but that figure is explicitly adapted from Ref. [76] and is not a new limit derived here. No coupling exclusion curve is produced. is_new_limit=false, is_projection=false (mass prediction, not a coupling sensitivity forecast).
